title: 56 High Speed Rail Links We Should've Built Already
summary: CityNerd lays out a data-driven method for deciding where high-speed rail should be built in North America and identifies 56 city pairs that justify it, based on population and distance.
why: HN recommends it as a methodical argument that many US city pairs make economic sense for high-speed rail.

quote.text: CityNerd identifies 56 train segments that should be built, using data and reasonable, precedented criteria
